BlockDecisionWire.description: PostToolUse supports only the block decision; a completed side effect cannot be undone.

additionalContext.description: Developer context added after the completed tool call.

description: Repository-local wire contract for the single JSON object a Codex PostToolUse apply-patch maintenance hook may write to stdout. This is the local owner subset, not a generic PostToolUse schema. A neutral success is silent; a decision object surfaces bounded feedback, and hookSpecificOutput adds refreshed model context.

reason.description: Model-visible explanation of the block; the emitting hook bounds its length and strips control characters.

systemMessage.description: Bounded user-visible diagnostic that does not alter the completed tool result.
